# QScrape

> A scraper evaluation e-shop by [Cascading Labs](https://cascadinglabs.com), used by [Yosoi](https://github.com/CascadingLabs/Yosoi).

VaultMart products and orders are synthetic test data.

## E-shop experiences

- [Plain HTML](/l1/eshop/): HTML/CSS and ordinary JavaScript. Product catalogue, search, product details, and a sample cart.
- [Modern Frameworks](/l2/eshop/): Client-only React, Vue, Svelte, and Solid islands. Framework assignment is shuffled per slot. Wait for asynchronous content to load.
- [Anti-bot](/l3/eshop/): Product data split across framework islands with CSS-ordered text, pseudo-elements, decoy overlays, canvas text, and closed Shadow DOM.
